# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Adjusted the root-zone oxygenation breakdown so the ROL bonus now saturates against the remaining substrate depth below the diffusive oxic front instead of the full bed depth. That removes phantom positive `root_oxygenation_bonus_cm` values when the substrate is already fully oxic, keeps the saturation smooth near full-depth penetration, and preserves tracing/budget output correctness. I also added regression coverage for the fully oxic case and updated the biomass/rate-scaling unit tests to hold the diffusive baseline shallow. In the habitat-geometry probe suite, I stopped the default duplicate multi-day executions by marking the five individual probe entrypoints as `#[ignore]` and leaving `all_habitat_geometry_probes_summary` as the default runner, with file-level guidance for running a single probe explicitly via `-- --ignored`.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspect the pending amendments in the substrate oxygenation breakdown and the habitat-geometry probe runner to confirm the exact failure modes and default test-execution pattern.
2. [Completed] Update the substrate ROL calculation to cap/saturate against remaining available depth, keeping the reported root bonus aligned with the actual effective penetration and adding a fully-oxic regression test plus adjusted bonus-scaling fixtures.
3. [Completed] Change the habitat-geometry probe file so ordinary `cargo test` runs execute only the aggregate summary while individual expensive probes remain available via `-- --ignored`, then rerun formatting and validation.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --lib systems::substrate::tests -- --nocapture` passed (24/24), including `fully_oxic_bed_reports_zero_root_oxygenation_bonus`.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test root_zone_oxygenation -- --nocapture` passed (5/5).
- `cargo test -p tank_core` passed across the full package test suite.
- `cargo clippy -p tank_core -- -D warnings` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_habitat_geometry_probes -- --nocapture` passed with the intended default shape: `all_habitat_geometry_probes_summary` ran once and the 5 individual probes were ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p tank_harness --test e2e_habitat_geometry_probes -- -D warnings` passed.

## Outstanding Risks

- Validation covered the full `tank_core` package and the touched `tank_harness` probe binary, but I did not rerun a full workspace-wide test suite outside those packages.
